items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: The Kentucky Club was just a little club with (inaudible) Leon Herrford (inaudible).

ctx.x: Yeah, because that's good to know, that he was an outstanding saxophone and clarinetist too. I didn't know that. Let's see, it said something about Paul's band was playing at the Kentucky Club on Central Avenue. Do you remember anything about the Kentucky Club?
Yeah. The Kentucky Club was just a little club with (inaudible) Leon Herrford (inaudible).
What about Lewis Taylor? Lewis Taylor?
